instruction_languages.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/IÉSEG School of Management/IESEG Exchange Program/IESEG_Lille-Paris_Exchange Program Factsheet_25-26.pdf#page=8
instruction_languages.notes: All business exchange courses in Grande Ecole Program are taught in English; free French as a Foreign Language (FFL) courses also offered (#page=9).

english_course_availability.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/IÉSEG School of Management/IESEG Exchange Program/IESEG_Lille-Paris_Exchange Program Factsheet_25-26.pdf#page=8

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: Working level of English requested; no official standardized test required for partner universities' exchange students. No RHET 1020 waiver stated.
english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/IÉSEG School of Management/IESEG Exchange Program/IESEG_Lille-Paris_Exchange Program Factsheet_25-26.pdf#page=7

fall_term_dates.value: AY 2025-2026: Term incl. exams Aug 25 – Dec 21, 2025 (arrival preferred Aug 19; mandatory orientation Aug 21–22).
fall_term_dates.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/IÉSEG School of Management/IESEG Exchange Program/IESEG_Lille-Paris_Exchange Program Factsheet_25-26.pdf#page=6

spring_term_dates.value: AY 2025-2026: Term incl. exams Jan 7 – May 31, 2026 (arrival Jan 2; orientation Jan 5–6).
spring_term_dates.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/IÉSEG School of Management/IESEG Exchange Program/IESEG_Lille-Paris_Exchange Program Factsheet_25-26.pdf#page=6

tuition_model.notes: Official ieseg.fr confirms exchange students from partner universities are exempt from tuition fees.

est_monthly_living_local.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/IÉSEG School of Management/IESEG Exchange Program/IESEG_Lille-Paris_Exchange Program Factsheet_25-26.pdf#page=13
est_monthly_living_local.notes: Fact Sheet budgets EUR 900–1,250/month on Lille campus and EUR 1,200–1,850/month on Paris (La Defense) campus.

living_cost_usd_est.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/IÉSEG School of Management/IESEG Exchange Program/IESEG_Lille-Paris_Exchange Program Factsheet_25-26.pdf#page=13
living_cost_usd_est.notes: 5-month estimate in EUR: midpoint 1375 EUR/month * 5 * 1.105200 USD/EUR = 7598.25 USD (1 EUR = 1.1052 USD; ECB 2026-11-13 reference rate collected 2026-11-15 at https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/policy_and_exchange_rates/euro_reference_exchange_rates/html/index.en.html). Fact Sheet budgets EUR 900–1,250/month on Lille campus and EUR 1,200–1,850/month on Paris (La Defense) campus.

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: OFII fiscal stamp €50; accommodation insurance €59/yr + civil liability insurance; ALL card €11 (Lille). Non-EU students register for free French Social Security (Ameli) and must provide a pre-arrival doctor medical attestation with vaccination record.
mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/IÉSEG School of Management/IESEG Exchange Program/IESEG_Lille-Paris_Exchange Program Factsheet_25-26.pdf#page=12

housing_availability.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/IÉSEG School of Management/IESEG Exchange Program/IESEG_Lille-Paris_Exchange Program Factsheet_25-26.pdf#page=10
housing_availability.notes: ISO sends housing booking instructions upon acceptance on a first-come, first-served basis (#page=10-11).

housing_notes.value: Estimated rent: Lille €450–€800/month (avg €600); Paris €600–€1,200/month (avg €850). CAF housing subsidy may apply after arrival.
housing_notes.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/IÉSEG School of Management/IESEG Exchange Program/IESEG_Lille-Paris_Exchange Program Factsheet_25-26.pdf#page=10

host_grants_or_stipends.value: French CAF housing subsidy (€30–€250/month possible for stays >=90 days with valid residence title and French bank account; 2+ months processing).
host_grants_or_stipends.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/IÉSEG School of Management/IESEG Exchange Program/IESEG_Lille-Paris_Exchange Program Factsheet_25-26.pdf#page=11

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: VLS-TS long-stay student visa required for >90 days (Schengen if <90 days), Campus France procedure where applicable, plus €50 OFII validation stamp post-arrival.
visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/IÉSEG School of Management/IESEG Exchange Program/IESEG_Lille-Paris_Exchange Program Factsheet_25-26.pdf#page=12

exchange_page_url.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/IÉSEG School of Management/IESEG Exchange Program/IESEG_Lille-Paris_Exchange Program Factsheet_25-26.pdf#page=1

course_catalog_url.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/IÉSEG School of Management/IESEG Exchange Program/IESEG_Lille-Paris_Exchange Program Factsheet_25-26.pdf#page=8

english_course_list_url.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/IÉSEG School of Management/IESEG Exchange Program/IESEG_Lille-Paris_Exchange Program Factsheet_25-26.pdf#page=8
english_course_list_url.notes: Dedicated Fall/Spring exchange course lists & syllabi for Lille and Paris.

credit_system_and_load.value: ECTS; regular load 30 ECTS (8–12 courses), minimum 20 ECTS; French 0–20 grading scale (10/20 pass); no retake exams for exchange students.
credit_system_and_load.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/IÉSEG School of Management/IESEG Exchange Program/IESEG_Lille-Paris_Exchange Program Factsheet_25-26.pdf#page=8

course_restrictions_note.value: Exchange restricted to Grande Ecole Program only. Bachelor students take Semester 6 (4th-year BA students may choose BA or Master); Master students take Master courses; no course changes after Learning Agreement signed.
course_restrictions_note.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/IÉSEG School of Management/IESEG Exchange Program/IESEG_Lille-Paris_Exchange Program Factsheet_25-26.pdf#page=8

value: Passport or EU ID card copy
required_application_docs.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/IÉSEG School of Management/IESEG Exchange Program/IESEG_Lille-Paris_Exchange Program Factsheet_25-26.pdf#page=7

campus_type.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/IÉSEG School of Management/IESEG Exchange Program/IESEG_Lille-Paris_Exchange Program Factsheet_25-26.pdf#page=1
campus_type.notes: Two campuses: Lille and Paris (La Defense), #page=1 & #page=5.

international_support_services.value: Mandatory Orientation Week, International Club buddy program/language cafe/events, free FFL French courses, and MAS disability support (mas-sante@ieseg.fr).
international_support_services.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/IÉSEG School of Management/IESEG Exchange Program/IESEG_Lille-Paris_Exchange Program Factsheet_25-26.pdf#page=3

nomination_deadlines.value: Fall / Academic Year: Nomination Apr 15, Application Apr 20; Spring: Nomination Sep 30, Application Oct 20.
nomination_deadlines.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/IÉSEG School of Management/IESEG Exchange Program/IESEG_Lille-Paris_Exchange Program Factsheet_25-26.pdf#page=7
